envelope.description: Publish task-based CR records with version-aware readers

body.title: Publish task-based CR records with version-aware readers
body.summary: Reuse the existing CR identity and canonical round writer for a version-2 task-based body, with its own validation/rendering and version-aware read/gate handling. Complete publication of the early task assessment without another model call where its checkpoint is compatible.
acceptanceChecks: New task-based CRs validate without fabricated DimensionResult fields or invocation of the legacy dimension/chunk engine; version-1 records keep their existing interpretation.
Permanent summaries retain selected scope, reviewer provenance, source-attempt attribution, findings, coverage strength, limitations and advice without copying full tool transcripts.
Publish idempotently by review-id/attempt and mark the attempt terminal only after the CR is durable; failures retain task results and pending publication.

New-format failed/incomplete/changes_requested results and unknown versions cannot become pass/no-review success; task-only pass is not whole-story signoff. Do not implement S3 approval cleanup. S1 changes only version/scope interpretation; approval-event wiring and deletion remain S3.
Show the early real assessment and its checkpoint projected into a readable canonical CR; reuse the recorded result rather than automatically re-review the subject.

tests.name: task-based CR: version-2 validation/rendering and version-1 compatibility without fabricated dimensions
CR publication: idempotent scoped summary and retained checkpoint on publication failure
CR readers: partial task scope, incomplete/failed results and unknown versions cannot satisfy story review
early installed review publication: saved actual assessment becomes canonical CR without another model review
